title: Rain
description: A rainy window with a song on. Drops bead, merge and run down the glass, each holding a tiny upside-down view of the photo outside; drag across the milky, fogged pane to wipe a clear, saturated streak. Pick Here Comes the Sun, Across the Universe or The Fool on the Hill and the view changes with it: a sunset under power lines, a light through night fog, a green valley.
intent: One physical surface finished to the edge: real water on real glass over a real photograph, where every drop is a lens and your finger is the only way to see out, with the song that goes with the view.
